name: antibodysystem-branded-docs
description: Branded document generator for AntibodySystem - Create professional PDFs, reports, proposals, and presentations with your company branding

scripts.example:letterhead: node src/cli.js generate letterhead examples/data/letterhead-example.json output/letterhead-example.pdf
scripts.example:report: node src/cli.js generate report examples/data/report-example.json output/report-example.pdf
scripts.example:proposal: node src/cli.js generate proposal examples/data/proposal-example.json output/proposal-example.pdf
scripts.example:presentation: node src/cli.js generate presentation examples/data/presentation-example.json output/presentation-example.pdf
scripts.examples:all: npm run example:letterhead && npm run example:report && npm run example:proposal && npm run example:presentation

author: AntibodySystem
